name: SS - Video Feature Reel
description: Vertical video feature reel with alternating video and editorial content rows. Each block has its own video, heading, text, stats, and CTA. Supports Shopify hosted video, YouTube/Vimeo, and MP4 URLs per block. Features alternating layout (video left/right), hover-to-play, glassmorphism/solid/minimal card styles, scroll-reveal animations, ambient glow, progress indicators, and accent dividers. Ideal for brand stories, product features, and campaign timelines. 70+ customization options.
